items.title: Pitch fee invoice 2027 season - Plot C14
items.body:
Dear Mr Thornton,

Please find your 2027 pitch fee for Plot C14 (Willerby, owner M. Thornton & family).

Pitch fee: £4,380.00
Rates and water: £612.00
Gas safety check (due March): £95.00
Total: £5,087.00

Payment is due in full by 31 January 2027, or by three instalments starting 1 December 2026. The park reopens for the season on 1 March 2027.

Kind regards,
Accounts Team, Sandcliffe Holiday Park, Filey

items.author: mick@thorntonheating.example
items.title: Caravan 2026 costs and weeks
items.body:
Dear Jan, Pete and Carol,

The park bill for 2026 has come in at £4,736 all in so that is £1,184 each between the four of us. Please can you pay me by the end of January into the usual account, same as last year.

The weeks are as follows as we agreed at Mums in October. Jan last week of July. Pete and Linda May half term. Carol Easter and the second week of September. Me and Bev the first week of June and whatever is left over.

I have had the gas checked and the water heater looked at, it is fine now. Please can everyone make sure the water is turned off at the stop tap when you leave as the park has warned us twice about it.

Any problems let me know.

Regards
Mick
